nom: Neutrogena Ultra Gentle Daily Face Moisturizer

segments.oily: One reviewer says her skin becomes very oily about an hour after applying, while another with combination skin says it keeps her oilier areas feeling fresh and hydrated without heaviness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including a teenager, report it helps with dryness without irritation; one describes the thicker version of the formula as sticky though effective.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin says it keeps her oilier areas feeling fresh and hydrated without a greasy or heavy feel.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including children with sensitive skin or eczema and one using it after a chemical peel, report no stinging, burning or breakouts and call it their most reliable moisturizer; one dissenting review reports severe burning eye irritation from a reformulated version marketed as a replacement for Neutrogena's old sensitive-skin moisturizer.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports the product burned her face badly within minutes on first use and left her unable to tolerate her usual gentle products afterward; another reviewer who says her skin is not very sensitive had no irritation and found it absorbed easily.

concerns.aging: One reviewer says the moisturizer helps with the look of wrinkles alongside dryness, though she describes the thicker formula as leaving a sticky feel.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe it as effectively hydrating without heaviness or grease, including use during dry winter months and one who calls it "pure, unadulterated hydration" after a chemical peel.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea says it works great for her skin and feels clean, not sticky; by contrast, one reviewer reports the product burned her face so badly it felt like it was on fire within minutes of a single use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer highlights the niacinamide and calming ingredients as helpful for strengthening the skin barrier, especially recommending it for sensitive skin; another says her granddaughter with moderate to severe eczema also finds it works well.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says it is the only moisturizer that doesn't cause breakouts on her sensitive skin; by contrast, another reports her skin started breaking out more after a reformulated version added new ingredients, one of which she found linked to acne in her research.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it absorbs without leaving a greasy or oily residue, including on combination skin's oilier areas; one dissenting review reports her skin became very oily about an hour after application.

aspects.libelle: Packaging sometimes arrives damaged or unsealed
Great value, tube lasts a long time
Tube's foil seal can be difficult or unsafe to open
A little product covers the whole face

extraits.texte: I really thought I would like this product for about the first 2 minutes. I liked the consistency, the way it went on smoothly and the fact it didn't take much to apply. After applying I went to wash my hands and noticed my face had started to get a burning sensation. It started with a slight burning at first but by the time I finished washing and drying my hands, my face felt like it was on fire. I've never had a product burn like this and I usually have normal skin so I would not recommend this for sensitive skin at all. I went straight to go wash it off and it felt like forever before I was able to get all the product off. Now even my gentle moisturizer burns when putting it on. This product damaged my skin in less than 5 minutes with only one use. I can't use any of the products I had been using for months in my skin care routine. Ultra gentle my @$$. I would not recommend this product

extraits.titre: Eye irritant — do not buy — burns and hurts eyes
extraits.texte: I hoped Neutrogena’s new Daily Facial Moisturizer would be a replacement for their old standby, Neutrogena’s Oil-free, fragrance-free, sensitive skin facial moisturizer, which they discontinued (see the photo with the purple bit on label). I am so sad. The new stuff is a toxic eye irritant— I only had it on briefly and my eyes cannot stop burning. Hurts a lot. Like getting nasty sunscreen in your eyes. Yes, the squeeze bottle is more convenient than the old pump, but I don’t wear the bottle on my face near my eyes. Neutrogena, **please** restore your old wonderful product, which I’d bought faithfully since the early 90s. Not the strongest moisturizer, but safe and non-irritating. Now please don’t mind me while I gauge out my burning eyes. Yeeooww this hurts. :-(

Ive been buying this moisturizer for several months and really liked it as it feels light, doesnt irritate my skin, and absorbs fast. The last bottle I got said "new look" on the top- I didnt think anything of it. After a couple of days my skin is breaking out more and more. I checked the label and sure enough- two new ingredients as compared to the bottle I got before this one! Butylene Glycol and Cantella Asiatica Extract. After checking online, it says that Cantella Asiatica "can cause acne". Thanks Neutrogena for telling us your bottle has a new look but not that you changed the formula!!
I'm not a fan of most of their products but this moisturizer is one of the better ones i've used. It is very hydrating but aftet an hour or so of wearing my skin got very oily.

I love this moisturizer. It feels clean on my face, not sticky. No scent. Great for my rosacea. BUT! Item was defective. The little foil piece that covers the nozzle would not come off using to scissors and a knife. The knife, however DID puncture the foil, go through and picture the tube, thereby cutting my finger. Trying to deal with Amazon is ridiculous, so I decided to write this review instead.

extraits.titre: Like a weighted blanket for my face.
extraits.texte: Like a weighted blanket for my face. Listen, my skin is more dramatic than a contestant on a reality dating show. If I so much as look at a scented candle, my face turns into a topographical map of a volcano. I’ve tried moisturizers that claimed to be "gentle" but felt like applying spicy habanero juice mixed with regret. Then came this Neutrogena bottle. Why it’s the GOAT: Total Silence: You know how some "fragrance-free" products still smell like a wet cardboard box or a doctor’s waiting room? This smells like... absolutely nothing. It’s the introverted moisturizer of my dreams. The Texture: It’s lightweight. Usually, "sensitive skin" creams are so thick you need a putty knife to spread them. This sinks in faster than my motivation to go to the gym on a Monday. The "No Sting" Guarantee: I applied this after a chemical peel that left me looking like a glazed ham. Zero stinging. Just pure, unadulterated hydration. It calmed my face down like a hostage negotiator. The Verdict: If your skin treats every external substance like a personal insult, you need this. My face and neck are finally living in peace. We’ve achieved a ceasefire. I no longer look like I’ve just finished a 12-round boxing match with a pollen cloud. Pros: No scent, no grease, no drama. Cons: It’s so good I’m worried it’ll leave me for someone with better bone structure.

This is a nice, lightweight daily moisturizer for daily use. No fragrance, which makes it even gentler on your skin. My tween daughter with sensitive skin loves it. My granddaughter who is also a tween with eczema which is moderate to severe also really loves it!! This product absorbs super easily and leaves no greasy, heavy feel. This product is from a great brand, Neutrogena, with a great amount of product for the price!
